name: Fichtengrund
beschreibung: The campsite Fichtengrund is located in the federal state of Tirol, Austria, in an alpine valley setting characterized by mountains and forests. The surrounding area includes several ski areas and a marked network of hiking trails. The atmosphere at the site is quiet. The facilities include sanitary facilities, electricity connections, and supply and disposal stations. There are pitches for motorhomes, caravans, and tents. The site is used as a starting point for activities in nature and for exploring the region. Overnight stays take place in a natural setting.
